question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3
solution:
The correct answer is "mostly"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given passage, the most appropriate answer for blank no.3 is 'mostly.'
 
• It is an adverb.
 
• An adverb is a word that describes or gives more information about a verb, adjective, adverb, or phrase.
 
 
• Example: *In the smaller towns, it is mostly very quiet at night*.
 
 
 
• In the above example, mostly means it will usually be quiet at night.
